name: agent-statusline-devtools
description: Dev-tooling only (NOT the application, NOT published). The statusline app is Python (installed via install.py / install.sh). This manifest exists solely to pin the aislop AI-slop gate so the per-edit hook and CI run a lockfile-integrity-verified LOCAL binary (node_modules/.bin/aislop) instead of `npx --yes aislop@x` against the live registry. aislop is the fork build @schoen/aislop (adds C#/roslynator + newer rules), served from the self-hosted Gitea npm registry (see .npmrc). Install with `npm ci --ignore-scripts`.
overridesComment: Patched floors for vulnerable TRANSITIVE dependencies of @schoen/aislop (the lint tool itself). This repo ships no runtime JavaScript, so none of these reach a user; they were failing aislop's own security engine and with it the CI gate. Each entry is the lowest published version outside the advisory range (npm audit 2026-08-03, see issue #23): tar GHSA <=7.5.20 critical, fast-uri 3.0.0-3.1.4 high, adm-zip <0.6.0 high, hono <4.12.34 moderate, @hono/node-server <2.0.5 moderate, body-parser 2.0.0-2.2.2 low, ip-address <=10.3.0 high. Drop an entry once the mtschoen/aislop fork bumps past it; npm warns on overrides that no longer apply.
